focus.purpose: Record the strongest player-facing life/continue projection without replacing the neutral address-level name or claiming the separate native health model.

hud.name: Render_BuildActorRecords
hud.effect: Seeds the player portrait/status record and converts GAME_DIFFICULTY_COUNTER minus ASCII '0' into the adjacent digit tile.

terminal_lifecycle.name: Level_ExitAndTerminalTransition
terminal_lifecycle.nonzero_effect: Decrements GAME_DIFFICULTY_COUNTER before the terminal reload path when the runtime-mode gate is clear.
terminal_lifecycle.zero_effect: Runs Hud_RunPendingDisplayPresentation and SceneResource_InitializeActiveScene instead of taking the nonzero reload branch.

observations.interpretation: The reset/scene initialization has published the normal observed HUD count.
The count remains independent while the apple word changes during the recorded A action.

independent_apple_projection.interpretation: The apple count changes from ASCII 10 to 09 while the player status digit remains ASCII 3.

qualification: The alias is a provisional semantic projection supported by initialization values, the portrait-adjacent HUD record, terminal decrement/zero branching, and the independent runtime apple-count observation. The exact product wording (lives versus continues) and any relationship to native health remain unresolved.
